Soldier

Overview

The mine guard is a witness in the investigation of Brissen’s murder. He let Yam-Akara enter with an expired permit because the magician had helped his village. His testimony leads Kir to the lost stamped pass, but the governor rejects the damaged document. The guard supplies a lead in clearing an innocent man; he does not settle the case alone. [1, 2]

Brissen’s murder and the failed alibi

Green leaves around the settlement lead Kir to Grey Leaf, who brings the news. Brissen is murdered and Yam-Akara is accused of killing his old friend. Kir and Kel undertake the defence. The magician says he spent the day in the mines and arrived late for their meeting. Soldier confirms that he allowed the elderly visitor through with an expired permit and stamped it that day. Kir finds the lost pass, but Valrasian rejects the water-damaged document because the signature and date can no longer be read. This evidence supports the search but does not free Yam-Akara; the travellers still have to identify the murderer. [3, 4, 5, 1, 2, 6, 7]
